# aTx Trusted Advisory (xFinance)

aTx Trusted Advisory is a fintech decision-support platform focused on options workflows. It combines strategy building, AI-assisted analysis, and portfolio context for educational use by approved users. It does not provide personalized investment advice.

## Key Product Pages
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/xoptions - xOptions workspace for options strategy workflows, chain context, and wheel-oriented execution support.
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/xchat - xChat workspace for AI-assisted options analysis, scenario exploration, and strategy rationale checks.

## Educational Pillars (Options Strategy Guides)
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/resources/getting-started - foundation guide: onboarding, options basics, strategy patterns, risk/disclosure orientation.
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/resources/building-wheel - wheel strategy playbook: cash-secured puts, covered-call cadence, premium targets, risk controls.
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/resources/building-wheel/wheel-vs-iron-condor - comparative educational guide for wheel and iron-condor frameworks.
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/resources/decision-workflow - decision workflow for evaluating opportunities and applying process discipline.
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/resources/secret-sauce - high-level explanation of how platform signals, context, and AI synthesis are combined.

## Disclaimers and Legal

## API and Documentation
- https://fintech-advisor.ai/api/openapi - OpenAPI document for available HTTP routes.

## Compliance Note
Educational conversations only. Not personalized investment advice. Content and model outputs are informational and illustrative; users remain solely responsible for investment decisions.
